_doc: Life: standing of each player with each sim faction, -100..100 (docs/tracks/life.md). Thresholds decide stance: at or below hostile_at the faction's guards and townsfolk treat you as a foe; at or above friendly_at they are friendly; raiders spare you only at raiders_spare_at. A Bond (Knack, rules.bond 'people:<culture>') sets bond_floor. Changes are added on the events below. grudge_s: how long attacking a faction's people on purpose makes it and its guards hostile to you. trade_per_coin: standing a coin of buying from or selling to a faction's shops earns, at most trade_cap from trade. A people's own thresholds (cultures.json stance: friendly_at, abroad and spare_at, toll) apply on top of these.
